name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Third-party REST API and MCP server that returns YouTube video transcripts and search results.
auth_notes: Bearer API key in the Authorization header. OAuth is offered for some MCP clients. No Google or YouTube Data API key is needed.
access_notes: Free signup with 100 credits and no card required. Paid plans start at $5/month for 1,000 credits, with top-ups at $2.50 per 1K. One credit per successful request.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free key, documented REST endpoints for transcript, search, channel, and playlist, and standard Bearer auth. Vendor works around YouTube access blocks, so terms and reliability need review.

identity.quote: Get transcripts, search videos, browse channels, and extract playlists via REST API or YouTube MCP

auth.quote: You sign in with your own TranscriptAPI credentials: an API key, or OAuth for some MCP clients.

access.quote: You can start for free: new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required,
Transcripts, search, channels, playlists — all endpoints, one credit each.

api_surface.quote: Get transcripts, search results, channel data

mcp.quote: claude mcp add --transport http transcript-api https://transcriptapi.com/mcp

buildability.quote: Get a free API key at transcriptapi.com/signup

needs_human_reason: This is a third-party service that the vendor says works around YouTube blocks, not YouTube's own API. Terms and legal review are needed before listing it. The vendor blog's claim that the official YouTube Data API cannot return auto-generated captions is unverified.
